name: – § 1, point h – Am 14
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a special committee on the Housing Crisis in the European Union, and defining its responsibilities, numerical strength and term of office
part_text: (h) to analyse effects of Union and ECB policies that influence the availability and affordability of housing, including migration policies, monetary policy, overregulation and bottlenecks in current Union regulations with regard to investment capacity, on housing and social housing, state aid and supply chain shortages;
